characters.description: Noel is a fast gunner-rushdown character who uses chained drive strings, stance-like routes, and rapid movement to keep pressure active.

characters.name: Orie
characters.art_alt: Orie from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: With the EXS of Purity, Thanatos , she can execute mid-range attacks, and perform a sharp single strike with the rushing attack Divine Thrust , making her strong in well-paced, sudden attacks.

characters.name: Rachel Alucard
characters.art_alt: Rachel Alucard from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Rachel Alucard's Drive is further amplified by both her mastery over sorcery and magic , which she often uses to summons bolts of lightning or teleport, on which there seemed to be little limit on how many she could transfer at one point.

characters.name: Ruby Rose
characters.art_alt: Ruby Rose from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: With her quick movement, she is a character that excels in hit-and-run tactics.

characters.name: Seth
characters.art_alt: Seth from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Seth is a speed-type rushdown fighter who closes distance for quick attacks and uses Captive Segment to create timed projectile pressure from either side.

characters.name: Teddie
characters.art_alt: Teddie from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Various effects may occur, from ranged attacks that activate automatically to the ability to regenerate health.

characters.name: Tsubaki Yayoi
characters.art_alt: Tsubaki Yayoi from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: When using Izayoi, Tsubaki is able to fight against most opponents on an even keel, and frequently switches between its whip and sword form for its blade.

characters.name: Vatista
characters.art_alt: Vatista from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Possessing a wealth of projectile skills, she's a character that excels at far-range battles.

characters.name: Waldstein
characters.art_alt: Waldstein from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Starting out with the command throw Drehen Durchbohren will let it be chained into a combo!

characters.name: Weiss Schnee
characters.art_alt: Weiss Schnee from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Weiss Schnee is a gameplay-focused BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle fighter whose neutral tools, pressure routes, and conversions define the character's gameplan.

characters.name: Yang Xiao Long
characters.art_alt: Yang Xiao Long from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Yang Xiao Long excels at close-range melee combat.

characters.name: Yosuke Hanamura
characters.art_alt: Yosuke Hanamura from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: With quick movements, and phantasmagoric skills like Dash Spring , fight while toying with the opponent!

characters.name: Yu Narukami
characters.art_alt: Yu Narukami from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: With skills like the ranged attack Zio and the rushing attack Swift Strike that are easy to use, for everyone from beginners to experts he's an easy-to-handle, well-rounded character.

characters.name: Yukiko Amagi
characters.art_alt: Yukiko Amagi from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Yukiko Amagi possesses a wide variety of mid-range to far-range attacks.

characters.name: Yumi
characters.art_alt: Yumi from BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle
characters.description: Yumi is a gameplay-focused BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle fighter whose neutral tools, pressure routes, and conversions define the character's gameplan.

characters.name: Akatsuki
characters.art_alt: Akatsuki from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: With a lack of effective longer-range options, mostly short range buttons and very favourable frame data, Akatsuki functions best as a close range brawler, using his close-range options to overwhelm players into making incorrect decisions and capitalizing on weaknesses for high damage.

characters.name: Blitztank
characters.art_alt: Blitztank from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Armor is a mechanic that allows Blitztank to continue performing a move even if it is hit.

characters.name: Byakuya
characters.art_alt: Byakuya from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: As such, Byakuya can easily train opponents to respect his pressure, allowing him to safely set up 214X webs for mixup and pressure (which can otherwise be disrespected by mashing) or simply do things that would otherwise be hugely unsafe (such as 5C dash up throw).

characters.name: Carmine
characters.art_alt: Carmine from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Essentially, the goal of Carmine's neutral game is to land any type of hit because he is able to convert stray hits into a full combo that ends in a knockdown to create a mix up/okizeme game after wards.

characters.name: Chaos
characters.art_alt: Chaos from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Chaos can also be very hard for the opponent to touch, thanks to his 6C, which pulls triple duty as an anti-air, a projectile reflector, and a combo starter, in addition to his Force Function, which allows him to weave out of aerial approaches and combo the opponent into the corner.

characters.name: Eltnum
characters.art_alt: Eltnum from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Lastly, Eltnum will suffer greatly from auto-piloting pressure, and needs to play in according to the opponent's shield habits.

characters.name: Enkidu
characters.art_alt: Enkidu from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Enkidu lacks projectiles, meterless reversals, full-screen normals, unreactable or vortexing mixups, and high-mobility specials, but in exchange, has access to great counterhit fishing, some rather crafty hurtbox shifting, and astounding corner damage.

characters.name: Gordeau
characters.art_alt: Gordeau from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Gordeau boasts some of the best footsies tool among the cast, with a mixture of kicks and punches that make him stressful to deal with up close, along with his scythe to poke out opponents at range.

characters.name: Hilda
characters.art_alt: Hilda from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Hilda is a character who has exceptional screen control and a large assortment of projectile attacks designed to keep her opponent at bay and essential zone them out.

characters.name: Hyde
characters.art_alt: Hyde from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Hyde is an all-rounder who covers approach angles with projectiles, punishes zoning, and turns corner carry into strong rushdown pressure.

characters.name: Kaguya
characters.art_alt: Kaguya from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Kaguya can use the double jump at any point after using her air dash while in the air, giving her increased aerial mobility and allowing for extended air combos.

characters.name: Kuon
characters.art_alt: Kuon from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Kuon has long-range specials to keep away or fight at range, but also has tools to close the gap when Kuon's turn arrives.

characters.name: Linne
characters.art_alt: Linne from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: With her defining projectile, Kuuga, and fast close-range pokes, she has little issue flipping a close-range neutral situation in her favor.

characters.name: Londrekia
characters.art_alt: Londrekia from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Londrekia also possesses some of the best corner carry in UNI and can spend meter to lock the opponent down on wakeup for a mixup, allowing him to easily snowball his neutral hits into corner setplay.

characters.name: Merkava
characters.art_alt: Merkava from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Merkava is a gameplay-focused UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late fighter whose neutral tools, pressure routes, and conversions define the character's gameplan.

characters.name: Mika
characters.art_alt: Mika from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Mika is a rushdown oriented character who uses her specials and movement speed to get into the opponent's face.

characters.name: Nanase
characters.art_alt: Nanase from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Nanase is a well-rounded character with very strong pressure and frametraps, as well as unorthodox mixups.

characters.name: Orie
characters.art_alt: Orie from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Orie is a very well-rounded character with a strong neutral game.

characters.name: Phonon
characters.art_alt: Phonon from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Played well, Phonon's pressure game is extremely oppressive, with no clear way out; and any mistake can be punished harshly with her high-damage combo game.

characters.name: Seth
characters.art_alt: Seth from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Seth is a speedy glass cannon who excels at close-range combat that is all about getting in by using his diverse movement options and independent orb projectile.

characters.name: Vatista
characters.art_alt: Vatista from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Vatista is a charge-based zoner who controls neutral with projectiles, then spends gems and air mobility to create close-range mixups.

characters.name: Wagner
characters.art_alt: Wagner from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Wagner is a proactive rushdown character who converts throws and command stomps into corner carry, strong mixups, and meter-amplified damage.

characters.name: Waldstein
characters.art_alt: Waldstein from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Waldstein excels in both close-range and mid-range scenarios due to having several ways of creating frame advantage (1A, 4B, 214X), normal attacks with great range and dominant hitboxes (5B, 2B, 5C), and the fastest command throw in the game (360A).

characters.name: Yuzehira
characters.art_alt: Yuzehira from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH Exe:Late[cl-r]
characters.description: Yuzehira has no overheads or throw in stance, but her frame traps, mobility, and ability to punish predictable opponents demand respect.

characters.name: Anre
characters.art_alt: Anre from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Anre is a well rounded character who uses guardpoints, parries, and his Spiral Spear to counter the opponent's offense and set up his own attacks.

characters.name: Avatar Belial
characters.art_alt: Avatar Belial from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Avatar Belial uses special-cancel routes into Pact to extend pressure and convert stray hits into flexible combo and resource sequences.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.art_alt: Beelzebub from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Beelzebub is a versatile hybrid zoning/pressure-based character who forces mistakes out of the opponent with his special attacks and unique movement.

characters.name: Belial
characters.art_alt: Belial from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Belial is a versatile pressure-based character who tricks the opponent with ambiguous special attacks.

characters.name: Cagliostro
characters.art_alt: Cagliostro from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Cagliostro is a setplay character who utilizes her traps and other special moves to lock down her opponents and swiftly evade them or intercept their attempts to deal with her traps when she isn't.

characters.name: Charlotta
characters.art_alt: Charlotta from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: If you can’t anti air it in time it is generally advised to block this low since the reward she gets off the overhead followup is considerably lower than if she catches you standing.

characters.name: Djeeta
characters.art_alt: Djeeta from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Djeeta is a well-rounded hybrid shoto with an emphasis on fireball and rekka pressure.

characters.name: Eustace
characters.art_alt: Eustace from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Eustace is a mid-range fighter who uses his variety of projectiles and grenades from Rat Race to control space and set up for combos and pressure.

characters.name: Ferry
characters.art_alt: Ferry from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Ferry is a zoning character who excels in harassing her opponent from afar and pulling them in to start extremely powerful pressure and okizeme.

characters.name: Gran
characters.art_alt: Gran from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Gran is a well-rounded character with many solid tools.

characters.name: Katalina
characters.art_alt: Katalina from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Katalina is a well-rounded character who plays footsies at a slightly longer range with her far-reaching attacks.

characters.name: Lancelot
characters.art_alt: Lancelot from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Lancelot is a tricky character whose speed and various mixup tools can overwhelm opponents at close range.

characters.name: Lowain
characters.art_alt: Lowain from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Lowain is a setup-focused gimmick character who summons allies, creates distractions, and uses the resulting space to start pressure.

characters.name: Metera
characters.art_alt: Metera from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Metera is a projectile zoner that controls space with multiple arrows and special movement.

characters.name: Narmaya
characters.art_alt: Narmaya from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Narmaya is a versatile character who switches between mid-range Dawnfly (Genji) stance and close-range Freeflutter (Kagura) stance.

characters.name: Nier
characters.art_alt: Nier from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: While Death is disabled, a gauge will appear underneath Nier's Skybound Gauge and she will be forced to refill her all her missing stocks before gaining access to Death again.

characters.name: Percival
characters.art_alt: Percival from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Percival is a pressure heavy character whose playstyle ramps up as he charges up stocks of powerups to buff his specials throughout the course of the match.

characters.name: Seox
characters.art_alt: Seox from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Seox is a rushdown character focusing on strike/throw mixups, thanks to a great arsenal of close range normals, plus on block special moves and unique movement options.

characters.name: Soriz
characters.art_alt: Soriz from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Soriz is a rushdown character who excels at pummeling his opponents with frame traps and strong up-close pressure.

characters.name: Vaseraga
characters.art_alt: Vaseraga from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Vaseraga is a mid-range control character with explosive damage and a unique toolkit of armor gimmicks.

characters.name: Vira
characters.art_alt: Vira from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: By landing 5U , or using Luminiera Merge , Vira will transform into her Luminiera Form , which grants the following effects:.

characters.name: Yuel
characters.art_alt: Yuel from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Yuel is a mobile, hybrid midrange rushdown character who controls space and applies pressure through the creative use of her normals and stance.

characters.name: Zeta
characters.art_alt: Zeta from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Zeta is an offense-oriented character who uses a mix of footsies and rushdown to attack from many ranges and angles.

characters.name: Zooey
characters.art_alt: Zooey from Granblue Fantasy: Versus
characters.description: Dragon Gauge allows Zooey to control Lyrn and have him do various attacks independently of her.

characters.name: A.K.I.
characters.art_alt: A.K.I. from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: A.K.I. is a poison-focused setplay fighter who uses puddles, long-range claws, and evasive movement to create layered pressure after poisoning the opponent.

characters.name: Akuma
characters.art_alt: Akuma from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Akuma has an overhead, a low, and a divekick, and each option can leave Akuma plus.

characters.name: Blanka
characters.art_alt: Blanka from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Many of his normals are also fairly strong for pokes and pressure, such as his light punches and kicks, his 5MP, his 2MP, and his 2MK, and if he can land a Punish Counter, then he can use Coward Crouch to set up for a launcher that does a lot of damage.

characters.name: Cammy
characters.description: 5MK, 2MP, and 2MK are especially good at mid-range poking, counter-poking, and punishing; 5HP, 2HP, and 5HK are built for punish countering big moves and giving Cammy room to advance on the opponent in various ways, whether they be links, hard knockdowns, target combos, or Drive Rush Cancels.
characters.art_alt: Cammy from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Chun-Li
characters.description: Thanks to her new Serenity Stance and Punish Counters, Chun gets great rewards off of whiff punishes in neutral without any meter required.
characters.art_alt: Chun-Li from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Dee Jay
characters.art_alt: Dee Jay from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: To this end, Dee Jay has a lot of very fast movement options; his forward dash and particularly his Drive Rush are incredibly quick, which pairs well with his many lengthy pokes.

characters.name: Dhalsim
characters.art_alt: Dhalsim from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Taking advantage of Forced Knockdown juggles is important for dealing with moves like Ken's Dragonlash, Dhalsim's Air Teleport, or Kimberly's 6HK~Hop sequence.

characters.name: E. Honda
characters.art_alt: E. Honda from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Oicho Throw (a damage-dealing command grab) and Sumo Smash (a combo finisher and anti-air that is plus on block) round out Honda's offense.

characters.name: Ed
characters.art_alt: Ed from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: This bad close-range offense even extends to his reversal options.

characters.name: Elena
characters.description: 2MP is a long poke for checking drive rush and counter poking.
characters.art_alt: Elena from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Guile
characters.description: If they block it, throw another one to chip away at their Drive Gauge.
characters.art_alt: Guile from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Jamie
characters.art_alt: Jamie from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Successful hits with sweep, Freeflow Strikes, Punish Counters, or any moves that knock the opponent down and away will give Jamie more time to drink without fear of repercussion, especially against opponents that aren't able to establish strong enough ranged pressure to stop Jamie from drinking when he's farther away from them.

characters.name: JP
characters.art_alt: JP from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: JP has access to Embrace , a fullscreen projectile command grab that gives JP excellent pressure opportunity on hit, looks just like Torbalan, and does high damage.

characters.name: Juri
characters.description: Juri's powerful ground presence is also enhanced by the speed and length of Juri's Drive Rush; getting caught by Drive Rush normals from her usually results in her cashing out for a fair bit of damage and at minimum getting a Fuhajin stock.
characters.art_alt: Juri from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Ken
characters.description: The Jinrai Series of kicks acts as great rekka pressure options in this scenario, and even come with built-in mixup tools.
characters.art_alt: Ken from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Kimberly
characters.art_alt: Kimberly from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: On the movement and neutral fronts, Kimberly not only has a high walk speed, a far-reaching Drive Rush and Drive Impact, and good pokes with 5MK and 5LK, but she also has the classic Bushinryu Sprint special move, which has a variety of different options to approach the opponent on the ground like the Shadow Slicer slide or the Neck Hunter overhead.

characters.name: Lily
characters.art_alt: Lily from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Lily is a mobile grappler who uses wind-stocked command grabs, advancing clubs, and Drive Rush to force close-range strike-throw pressure.

characters.name: Luke
characters.description: Many of Luke's normals lunge him forward, which synergizes with Drive Rush to create hard-to-escape pressure sequences and surprise whiff punish opportunities.
characters.art_alt: Luke from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: M. Bison
characters.art_alt: M. Bison from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: It even leads into a full combo when used from Drive Rush, giving Bison another layer of mixup beyond his usual repertoire.

characters.name: Mai
characters.description: Mai's excellent 4HK anti-air doubles as a strong meaty pressure tool, and her 6MP overhead comes with all the standard benefits.
characters.art_alt: Mai from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Manon
characters.art_alt: Manon from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: To complement these two moves and her medal system, Manon's long limbs let her play a strong mid-range game to poke and prod the opponent, with quite a few of her grounded and jumping normals having long reach, and several moves having target combo follow-ups that pull the opponent in or otherwise reposition them for Manon to throw them.

characters.name: Marisa
characters.art_alt: Marisa from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Obviously, just striking isn't going to open a defensive opponent, which is why she has Scutum , an armored stance with access to an overhead, a low, and quite possibly her most frightening move, a command grab.

characters.name: Rashid
characters.art_alt: Rashid from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: If you want peerless mobility, excellent close-range pressure and a wealth of style alongside it, ride the waves with Rashid.

characters.name: Ryu
characters.description: Hashogeki is a combo tool and pressure tool, giving Ryu a new way to end blockstrings or even reset pressure completely especially when Denjin is spent to either give Ryu easy access to juggles or plus frames on block.
characters.art_alt: Ryu from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Terry
characters.description: LP Power Wave travels on the ground much like Juri's enhanced Saihasho does, enabling it to sneak under higher projectiles and hitboxes, while MP Power Wave loses a bit of range in exchange for clashing with regular fireballs and OD Power Wave is a multi-hit projectile that's great for pressure and approaches; Round Wave eschews a projectile entirely, keeping the fireball clash property, and serves as a fireball bait from further away and a powerful pressure and okizeme tool up close.
characters.art_alt: Terry from Street Fighter 6

characters.name: Zangief
characters.art_alt: Zangief from Street Fighter 6
characters.description: Zangief loses access to some of his best neutral tools with Modern, 5MK and 2MK , both very valuable pokes with huge range while being relatively safe against Drive Impact .

characters.name: Alisa Bosconovitch
characters.art_alt: Alisa Bosconovitch from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Alisa combines long-range pokes with rocket mobility, detachable chainsaws, and evasive movement that keeps her difficult to pin down.

characters.name: Anna Williams
characters.art_alt: Anna Williams from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Anna is a mixup specialist who uses evasive movement, threatening lows, and stance-based strings to turn close-range openings into volatile offense.

characters.name: Armor King
characters.art_alt: Armor King from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Armor King is a grappler with strong pokes, chain throws, running pressure, and high-damage command grabs that punish passive defense.

characters.name: Asuka Kazama
characters.art_alt: Asuka Kazama from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Asuka is a defensive counter-fighter who uses sabaki attacks, reversals, and strong keepout buttons to turn aggression into punishes.

characters.name: Azucena Milagros Ortiz Castillo
characters.art_alt: Azucena Milagros Ortiz Castillo from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Azucena uses evasive stance movement, advancing strikes, and coffee-fueled stance mixups to maintain momentum at close range.

characters.name: Bob
characters.art_alt: Bob from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Bob is a speed-focused all-rounder who combines rapid movement, spinning attacks, and balanced pokes to win neutral without sacrificing damage.

characters.name: Bryan Fury
characters.art_alt: Bryan Fury from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Bryan is a counter-hit specialist who converts keepout buttons into wall pressure, taunt setups, and explosive frame traps.

characters.name: Claudio Serafino
characters.art_alt: Claudio Serafino from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Claudio is a compact whiff-punisher whose hopkick, strong mids, and Starburst resource make neutral mistakes highly costly.

characters.name: Clive Rosfield
characters.art_alt: Clive Rosfield from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Clive controls unusual distances with his greatsword, long-reaching mids, and Phoenix Shift movement before cashing out through Heat.

characters.name: Devil Jin
characters.art_alt: Devil Jin from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Devil Jin pairs Mishima electrics and hellsweeps with lasers, flight-like movement, and Heat-enhanced pressure for explosive conversions.

characters.name: Eddy Gordo
characters.art_alt: Eddy Gordo from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Eddy uses Capoeira stances, low-profile movement, and flowing kick strings to evade attacks and build momentum through close pressure.

characters.name: Fahkumram
characters.art_alt: Fahkumram from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Fahkumram uses exceptional limb range, powerful knees, and frame-trap pressure to dominate midrange and carry opponents to the wall.

characters.name: Feng Wei
characters.art_alt: Feng Wei from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Feng uses evasive movement, long-reaching pokes, sabaki tools, and stance attacks to win neutral while sidestepping retaliation.

characters.name: Heihachi Mishima
characters.art_alt: Heihachi Mishima from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Heihachi is a classic Mishima bruiser who uses electrics, powerful mids, and stance pressure to force close-range respect.

characters.name: Hwoarang
characters.art_alt: Hwoarang from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Hwoarang overwhelms opponents with stance-based kick strings that branch into layered lows, mids, frame traps, and evasive Flamingo pressure.

characters.name: Jack-8
characters.art_alt: Jack-8 from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Jack-8 is a big-body keepout fighter who combines huge-range normals, armored power moves, and Heat-enhanced pressure.

characters.name: Jin Kazama
characters.art_alt: Jin Kazama from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Jin is a versatile Mishima-style all-rounder who blends electric launchers, parries, stance transitions, and Heat pressure across every range.

characters.name: Jun Kazama
characters.art_alt: Jun Kazama from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Jun is a balanced fighter who converts clean pokes into stance pressure while using healing and defensive techniques to manage risk.

characters.name: Kazuya Mishima
characters.description: Kazuya is a Mishima pressure specialist who uses wavedash movement, electric uppercuts, hellsweeps, and Heat to turn small openings into devastating offense.
characters.art_alt: Kazuya Mishima from TEKKEN 8

characters.name: King
characters.art_alt: King from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: King is a grappler who uses chain throws, command grabs, long-range pokes, and wall pressure to make close defense costly.

characters.name: Kuma
characters.art_alt: Kuma from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Kuma uses bear-specific stances, unusual movement, and large-range attacks to turn awkward spacing into powerful punish and wall pressure.

characters.name: Kunimitsu
characters.art_alt: Kunimitsu from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Kunimitsu uses ninja mobility, teleporting approaches, knife attacks, and quick stance mixups to create fast side-switching pressure.

characters.name: Lars Alexandersson
characters.art_alt: Lars Alexandersson from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Lars uses rapid stance transitions and lightning-fast movement to turn advancing strings into left-right pressure and wall carry.

characters.name: Lee Chaolan
characters.art_alt: Lee Chaolan from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Lee is a technical keepout fighter who rewards precise just-frame inputs, Mist Step movement, and whiff punishment into stylish combos.

characters.name: Leo Kliesen
characters.art_alt: Leo Kliesen from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Leo is a balanced midrange fighter who uses reliable pokes, stance transitions, and wall-carry routes to shift smoothly between defense and pressure.

characters.name: Leroy Smith
characters.art_alt: Leroy Smith from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Leroy controls midrange with safe pokes and parries, then uses stance transitions and his cane attacks to punish overextension.

characters.name: Lidia Sobieska
characters.art_alt: Lidia Sobieska from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Lidia is a karate-based pressure character whose stance transitions, strong mids, and Heat-enhanced offense reward disciplined forward movement.

characters.name: Lili Rochefort
characters.art_alt: Lili Rochefort from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Lili uses exceptional sidestep movement, long-reaching pokes, and evasive stance attacks to control space and create side-switching mixups.

characters.name: Ling Xiaoyu
characters.art_alt: Ling Xiaoyu from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Xiaoyu relies on evasive stances, sidesteps, and close-range mixups to make attacks whiff before she re-enters with fast pressure.

characters.name: Marshall Law
characters.art_alt: Marshall Law from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Marshall Law is a fast rushdown fighter who chains martial-arts strings, slides, and nunchaku attacks into relentless close pressure.

characters.name: Miary Zo
characters.art_alt: Miary Zo from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Miary Zo is a mobile stance fighter who uses long kicks, evasive movement, and branching pressure to contest midrange safely.

characters.name: Nina Williams
characters.art_alt: Nina Williams from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Nina is a technical pressure character built around fast pokes, string extensions, sidestep offense, and damaging chain throws.

characters.name: Panda
characters.art_alt: Panda from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Panda shares a big-body bear gameplan built around unusual stances, long normals, and high-reward wall pressure.

characters.name: Paul Phoenix
characters.art_alt: Paul Phoenix from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Paul is a high-damage punish character whose heavy punches, Deathfist, and guard-breaking pressure make every whiff dangerous.

characters.name: Raven
characters.art_alt: Raven from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Raven combines long-range pokes, clone attacks, teleport movement, and stance transitions to create deceptive neutral and side-switching offense.

characters.name: Reina
characters.art_alt: Reina from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Reina combines Mishima electrics with multiple stance transitions, evasive movement, and Heat pressure to sustain aggressive close-range offense.

characters.name: Sergei Dragunov
characters.art_alt: Sergei Dragunov from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Dragunov builds suffocating pressure from long-range pokes, Running 2, plus-frame strings, and strong wall positioning.

characters.name: Shaheen
characters.art_alt: Shaheen from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Shaheen controls neutral with compact pokes, slide approaches, and Stealth Step transitions that threaten quick lows and launchers.

characters.name: Steve Fox
characters.art_alt: Steve Fox from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Steve is a boxing specialist who attacks through weaving movement, counter-hit punches, and stance transitions instead of conventional kicks.

characters.name: Victor Chevalier
characters.art_alt: Victor Chevalier from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Victor controls space with weapon reach, teleporting entries, and stance-based pressure that converts midrange hits into strong wall carry.

characters.name: Yoshimitsu
characters.art_alt: Yoshimitsu from TEKKEN 8
characters.description: Yoshimitsu mixes sword-range pokes, evasive stances, teleport tricks, and risky utility moves to create matchup-specific surprises.

characters.name: Zafina
characters.description: Zafina uses three evasive stances, unusual hurtbox movement, and long-reaching attacks to create awkward neutral and layered mixups.
characters.art_alt: Zafina from TEKKEN 8

characters.name: Akatsuki
characters.art_alt: Akatsuki from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: With a lack of effective longer-range options, mostly short range buttons and very favourable frame data, Akatsuki functions best as a close range brawler, using his close-range options to overwhelm players into making incorrect decisions and capitalizing on weaknesses for high damage.

characters.name: Blitztank
characters.art_alt: Blitztank from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Armor is a mechanic that allows Blitztank to continue performing a move even if it is hit.

characters.name: Byakuya
characters.art_alt: Byakuya from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Byakuya also has a few tricky mixup tools that can catch opponents off guard to close out rounds in a command grab and a variable timing high/low in 214~A/C.

characters.name: Carmine
characters.art_alt: Carmine from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Essentially, the goal of Carmine's neutral game is to land any type of hit because he is able to convert stray hits into a full combo that ends in a knockdown to create a mix up/okizeme game after wards.

characters.name: Enkidu
characters.art_alt: Enkidu from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Enkidu lacks projectiles, meterless reversals, full-screen normals, unreactable or vortexing mixups, and high-mobility specials, but in exchange, has access to great counterhit fishing, some rather crafty hurtbox shifting, and astounding corner damage.

characters.name: Gordeau
characters.art_alt: Gordeau from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: With some great mix-up potential when he gets in, including a command grab, multiple standing overheads, and some of the best pressure normals in the game such as 5B, he's quite threatening when he gets within his effective range.

characters.name: Hilda
characters.art_alt: Hilda from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Hilda is a character who has exceptional screen control and a large assortment of projectile attacks designed to keep her opponent at bay and essentially zone them out.

characters.name: Hyde
characters.art_alt: Hyde from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Hyde performs well at all ranges, able to zone and cover his approach with moves like Black Orbiter and Blaring Outrage and counter zoners and long range attacks with Shadow Scare (and Blaring Outrage), while moves like 66C help him close the distance and start running pressure.

characters.name: Kaguya
characters.art_alt: Kaguya from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Kaguya can use the double jump at any point after using her air dash while in the air, giving her increased aerial mobility and allowing for extended air combos.

characters.name: Kuon
characters.art_alt: Kuon from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Kuon has long-range specials to keep away or fight at range, but also has tools to close the gap when Kuon's turn arrives.

characters.name: Linne
characters.art_alt: Linne from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Linne is an extremely agile character that excels in closing distances with superior speed, then winning scrambles at mid to close range and keeping people locked down with strong pressure.

characters.name: Londrekia
characters.art_alt: Londrekia from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Londrekia also possesses some of the best corner carry in UNI and can set up blossom oki off of almost any combo, allowing him to easily snowball his neutral hits into scary strike/throw oki.

characters.name: Merkava
characters.art_alt: Merkava from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Merkava can press up while in the air to enter flight.

characters.name: Mika
characters.art_alt: Mika from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Mika is a rushdown character who uses her specials and movement speed to get into the opponent's face.

characters.name: Nanase
characters.art_alt: Nanase from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Nanase is a well-rounded character with very strong pressure and frame traps.

characters.name: Ogre
characters.art_alt: Ogre from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Ogre's base movement isn't very fast, with his dash having 7 frames of startup and that combined with his normals mostly lacking significant range means he relies more on his lunging attacks and projectiles to create opportunitites to get in close.

characters.name: Orie
characters.art_alt: Orie from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Orie is a very well-rounded character with a strong neutral game.

characters.name: Phonon
characters.art_alt: Phonon from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Played well, Phonon's pressure game is extremely oppressive, with no clear way out; and any mistake can be punished harshly with her high-damage combo game.

characters.name: Seth
characters.art_alt: Seth from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Seth is a speedy glass cannon who excels at close-range combat that is all about getting in by using his diverse movement options and independent orb projectile.

characters.name: Tsurugi
characters.art_alt: Tsurugi from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Once he is in he has very strong strike/throw with access to a solid array of buttons and a pseudo-command grab to punish his opponents for trying to shield his offense.

characters.name: Uzuki
characters.art_alt: Uzuki from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Uzuki is a hybrid rushdown/space control character, being able to both control neutral, and run incredible stagger pressure.

characters.name: Vatista
characters.art_alt: Vatista from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Vatista is an incredibly versatile and uniquely powerful charge character who excels in controlling the pace of neutral with projectiles like Mico Ruseo and Lumen Stella , in order to leverage her approach and begin utilising Si Deus Fragmentum 'Gems' and Trans Volans in up close pressure for scary throw and high/low mixups.

characters.name: Wagner
characters.art_alt: Wagner from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Wagner can use her 22X move, Lohen Schneide , to activate either Sword Enhance or Shield Enhance.

characters.name: Waldstein
characters.art_alt: Waldstein from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Waldstein excels in both close-range and mid-range scenarios due to having several ways of creating frame advantage (1A, 4B, 214X, 22X), normal attacks with great range and dominant hitboxes (5B, 2B, 5C), and the fastest attack in the game in the form of a command throw (360A).

characters.name: Yuzehira
characters.art_alt: Yuzehira from UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
characters.description: Yuzehira has no overheads or throw in stance, but her frame traps, mobility, and ability to punish predictable opponents demand respect.

characters.name: Black Panther
characters.art_alt: Black Panther from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Black Panther is a close-range attacker who uses pouncing movement, claw strings, and rapid space-closing pressure.

characters.name: Blade
characters.art_alt: Blade from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Blade blends sword normals and firearms to control midrange, then uses fast advancing attacks to keep opponents locked down.

characters.name: Captain America
characters.art_alt: Captain America from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Captain America is a balanced fighter who combines shield projectiles, advancing strikes, and defensive timing to move safely into pressure.

characters.name: Carnage
characters.art_alt: Carnage from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Carnage is an aggressive close-range fighter who extends pressure with symbiote limbs, rapid angles, and high-damage conversions.

characters.name: Danger
characters.art_alt: Danger from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Danger charges the Bast’s Blessing Gauge with long-range spear attacks and projectiles, then spends that resource to reinforce her offense.

characters.name: Deadpool
characters.art_alt: Deadpool from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Deadpool mixes gunfire, sword attacks, and unpredictable movement to harass at range before rushing into chaotic pressure.

characters.name: Doctor Doom
characters.art_alt: Doctor Doom from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Doctor Doom controls space with armored magic attacks, projectiles, and summoned technology before forcing opponents to approach.

characters.name: Ghost Rider
characters.art_alt: Ghost Rider from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Ghost Rider controls lanes with chain attacks and fire projectiles, using long reach to keep opponents outside their preferred range.

characters.name: Green Goblin
characters.art_alt: Green Goblin from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Green Goblin uses glider mobility, bombs, and trap-like projectiles to disrupt neutral and force awkward defensive choices.

characters.name: Hulk
characters.art_alt: Hulk from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Hulk is a power grappler who uses armored approaches, huge normals, and command-grab threats to make close defense break down.

characters.name: Iron Man
characters.art_alt: Iron Man from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Iron Man uses flight, repulsors, and multi-angle aerial movement to control space before converting a projectile opening into pressure.

characters.name: Loki
characters.art_alt: Loki from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Loki relies on teleporting misdirection, illusion-based movement, and tricky attack timing to make his pressure difficult to read.

characters.name: Magik
characters.art_alt: Magik from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Magik uses sword reach, teleporting movement, and portal-based approach changes to create deceptive mixups at close and midrange.

characters.name: Magneto
characters.art_alt: Magneto from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Magneto combines aerial mobility, magnetic projectiles, and fast movement changes to create layered approach and reset pressure.

characters.name: Ms. Marvel
characters.art_alt: Ms. Marvel from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Ms. Marvel uses polymorphing limbs, elastic reach, and agile aerial approaches to extend pressure from unexpected distances.

characters.name: Peni Parker
characters.art_alt: Peni Parker from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Peni Parker uses her SP//dr mech, ranged tools, and assist-like pressure to control space before closing in behind its attacks.

characters.name: Spider-Man
characters.art_alt: Spider-Man from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Spider-Man is a mobility-focused rushdown fighter who uses Web Zip to change approach angles and branch into fast follow-ups.

characters.name: Star-Lord
characters.art_alt: Star-Lord from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Star-Lord controls midrange with blasters, gadgets, and airborne movement that let him keep pressure active while repositioning.

characters.name: Storm
characters.art_alt: Storm from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Storm controls the air and ground with wind movement, lightning projectiles, and weather-based space denial.

characters.name: Wolverine
characters.art_alt: Wolverine from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
characters.description: Wolverine is a fast rushdown fighter who uses advancing claws, air mobility, and relentless close-range frame pressure.
